Name: DEPRECATED - Baechu-styled portraits for SVE
Author: AkiraE
Description:
[center][color=#ff7700][size=4]I no longer have the time to maintain this mod, and, even if I had, I lack the interest for doing so, as I no longer play the game or have it installed. 
[/size][/color]
[size=4][b][/b][/size][size=4][b]I'm keeping the mod up per request, but keep in mind that it is highly outdated and I no longer offer any support for it.
[/b][/size][color=#ff7700][size=4]A[/size][size=3]nd by "highly outdated" I mean that you will very likely see the vanilla portraits in a few cases and so on.[/size][/color][size=2]

[/size]
[size=3]═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════[/size]

[size=3]﻿Hello! :)[/size]

[size=3]This is a set of retextures of SVE portraits in Baechu's style, made to match [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5397]this set of Seasonal Portraits﻿[/url][size=3]﻿ I've released in the past.[/size]
[size=3]This set containts every SVE character, except for Marlon.[/size][/center][center]﻿

═════════════════  *.·:·.☽✧    ✦    ✧☾.·:·.*  ═════════════════


[size=4][b]REQUIREMENTS[/b][/size]
[size=3]
 ✦  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿﻿
[/size][/center][center]
═════════════════  *.·:·.☽✧    ✦    ✧☾.·:·.*  ═════════════════


[b][size=4]INSTALLATION[/size]

[size=3]You [u]must[/u] have SVE installed beforehand.[/size][/b][size=3]

✦ Unzip the files and drop the folder [b]inside[/b] "[Stardew] Baechu-styled SVE portraits"
into your main mods folder and allow the files to be replaced.
[/size]
(You will need to reinstall my portraits every time you update SVE, so keeping a copy of them in a easily reachable place would be wise). [size=3]﻿

[/size][/center][center][size=3]
═════════════════  *.·:·.☽✧    ✦    ✧☾.·:·.*  ═════════════════


[/size][size=4][b]CREDITS[/b][/size] [/center][size=3]
[/size][center][size=3]My retextures consists of frankensteined and edited assets from existing portraits by Baechu﻿, therefore,
these portraits are not my original artwork.

The portraits I used to make my edits are avaible [url=https://cafe.naver.com/starvall/72339]here[/url]﻿.
[/size][/center][size=3]
[/size][center][size=3]﻿My thanks to Baechu for letting me edit her portraits and to FlashShifter and all the artists involved in SVE. <3

[/size][size=1]also, I'm not a native english speaker, sorry lol[/size][/center]
